---
title: "Blog"
description: "Extended articles that connect short social-media communication with structured classes and training materials."
---

The Blog is the **middle layer of a teaching communication pathway**. It is not a publication catalogue and it is not a substitute for a class repository.

The intended reader journey is:

**Social post → extended Blog article → structured class in Teaching**

The editorial workflow runs in the opposite direction:

**Class or teaching theme → extended Blog article → short social-media post**

Formal scholarly outputs, including scientific notes intended as citable research products, belong under [Publications](/publications/), not here.
